findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 960 requests to 157 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

89 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), agkn.com (Neustar (TransUnion), advertising).
419 cookies were set by third-party domains (451 cookies in total).
